title: Clinical Research Assistant II-The Program for Language Equity

cond_0001.intro: [Company name masked] is looking for a Clinical Research Assistant II to support the activities of a language equity program, in collaboration with the program director and a program manager. The program's goal is to transform research and healthcare delivery—through a combination of research, education, and advocacy—to include and prioritize individuals who communicate in languages other than English. A core guiding principle is that language should be a strength, not a barrier, and that empowering communities through linguistic inclusion can lead to higher quality, safer, and more equitable care for all.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Conducting mixed-methods language equity-focused research, including qualitative research, intervention research, benchmarking, and research with large datasets.
Supporting a multilingual translation and cultural adaptation collaborative to help researchers and clinicians in effective translation practices.
Creating a library of translated research and clinical materials.
Assisting with publishing scholarship promoting language equity.
Creating training materials for clinicians and researchers on language equity best practices.
Maintaining the program website and social media.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in STEM or Psychology with a minimum of 2 years of research experience.
A minimum of one year of work experience.
Strong attention to detail, and strong organizational, interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
A commitment to language equity.
Preferred Requirements
A two-year time commitment.
Bilingual skills.
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

Conducting mixed-methods language equity-focused research, including qualitative research, intervention research, benchmarking, and research with large datasets.

Creating a library of translated research and clinical materials.
Assisting with publishing scholarship promoting language equity.
Creating training materials for clinicians and researchers on language equity best practices.
Maintaining the program website and social media.

Bachelor's degree in STEM or Psychology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
